"""Lexicon lookup over data/lexicon/tla_lexicon.json (PLAN.md §4).

Three tiers, each marked on the candidate so later layers can weigh it:
  1  exact key            (forms attested in the TLA corpus, then lemma-list entries)
  2  "+loose"             same key without hyphens — only when tier 1 finds nothing
  3  "+strip:<ending>"    key with a grammatical ending removed, or the unwritten final j of weak
                          verbs added back — always added, ranked after 1–2
"""
import json
import re
import unicodedata
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
LEXICON = ROOT / "data" / "lexicon" / "tla_lexicon.json"

POS_NAME = {"noun": "NOUN", "verb": "VERB", "proper noun": "PROPN", "adjective": "ADJ", "preposition": "ADP",
            "pronoun": "PRON", "adverb": "ADV", "grammatical particle": "PART", "numeral": "NUM",
            "interjection": "INTJ"}

# (ending, replacement, label). Order matters: longer endings first.
ENDINGS = [
    ("wt", "t", "-wt→-t"),   # feminine plural → feminine singular (spꜣwt → spꜣt)
    ("wt", "", "-wt"),
    ("tj", "t", "-tj→-t"),   # dual feminine → feminine singular (rwtj → rwt)
    ("tj", "", "-tj"),       # stative 2s, 3fs; nisbe
    ("wj", "", "-wj"),       # dual masculine
    ("w", "", "-w"),         # plural / stative 3ms, 3pl
    ("t", "", "-t"),         # feminine / infinitive
    ("t", "j", "-t→-j"),     # infinitive of 3ae-inf verbs (ḥwt → ḥwj)
]
MIN_STEM = 2


def skeleton(text):
    """Comparison key shared by TLA (LUT) and our transliteration.

    Drops what the two conventions write differently: yod (ꞽ, ï and weak i̯ vs j), q vs ḳ, morpheme
    dots, '=' before suffix pronouns, brackets, aleph-like ʾ, grammatical tags (.PL), case, and z/s.
    Letters with diacritics (ḥ ḫ ẖ ṯ ḏ š) are kept distinct.
    """
    t = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", re.sub(r"\.[A-Z]+", "", text))   # .PL, .DU
    t = t.replace("i̯", "j").replace("̯", "").replace("ꞽ", "j").replace("Ꞽ", "j").replace("ï", "j")
    t = t.replace("ʾ", "")
    t = re.sub(r"[.=()\[\]⸢⸣〈〉{}]", "", t)
    return t.lower().replace("z", "s").replace("ḳ", "q")


def stripped_keys(k, weak_j=True):
    """Tier-3 keys: one ending removed, or a doubled final consonant reduced (sjnn → sjn).
    weak_j adds the final j that 3ae-inf verbs drop in sḏm.f / sḏm.n.f (gm.n → gmj, ꜥẖ.f → ꜥẖj)."""
    out = [(k + "j", "+j")] if weak_j and not k.endswith("j") else []
    for end, repl, label in ENDINGS:
        if k.endswith(end):
            stem = k[: -len(end)]
            if len(stem.replace("-", "")) >= MIN_STEM:
                out.append((stem + repl, label))
    if len(k) >= 3 and k[-1] == k[-2]:
        out.append((k[:-1], "gem"))
        out.append((k[:-1] + "j", "gem+j"))  # geminated 3ae-inf verb (sjnn → sjnj)
    seen, uniq = {k}, []
    for key, label in out:
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            uniq.append((key, label))
    return uniq


class Lexicon:
    def __init__(self, path=LEXICON):
        with open(path, encoding="utf8") as f:
            self.data = json.load(f)

    def _exact(self, k, via):
        out, seen = [], set()
        for f in self.data["forms"].get(k, []):
            out.append({"id": f["id"], "freq": f["freq"], "upos": max(f["upos"], key=f["upos"].get), "via": "form" + via})
            seen.add(f["id"])
        for i in self.data["lemma_index"].get(k, []):
            if i not in seen:
                e = self.data["lemmas"][i]
                upos = max(e["upos"], key=e["upos"].get) if e["upos"] else POS_NAME.get(e["pos"], e["pos"])
                out.append({"id": i, "freq": e["corpus_freq"], "upos": upos, "via": "lemma" + via})
                seen.add(i)
        return out

    def candidates(self, k, strip=True, weak_j=True):
        out = self._exact(k, "")
        if not out:
            for k2 in self.data["loose_index"].get(k.replace("-", ""), []):
                out += self._exact(k2, "+loose")
        if strip:
            seen, tier3 = {c["id"] for c in out}, []
            for k3, label in stripped_keys(k, weak_j):
                for c in self._exact(k3, f"+strip:{label}"):
                    if c["id"] not in seen:
                        seen.add(c["id"])
                        tier3.append(c)
            out += sorted(tier3, key=lambda c: -c["freq"])  # within tier 3, the commoner lemma first
        for c in out:
            c["upos"] = POS_NAME.get(c["upos"], c["upos"])
        return out

    def lemma(self, tla_id):
        return self.data["lemmas"][tla_id]

"""Free-text entry point (PLAN.md §8): a typed transliteration → words → engine output.

One sentence per line. Accepts our Unicode transliteration (ḥm.f) or Manuel de Codage (Hm=f); the
same file runs in the browser under Pyodide, so it uses only the standard library.
"""
import re
import unicodedata

from irab.engine import Engine
from irab.retokenize import load_lexicon, segment, to_json, words_from

UNI = set("ꜣꜥḥḫẖšṯḏḳꞽ")
MDC = {"A": "ꜣ", "a": "ꜥ", "H": "ḥ", "x": "ḫ", "X": "ẖ", "S": "š", "T": "ṯ", "D": "ḏ", "q": "ḳ", "i": "j"}


def normalize(line):
    """MdC → Unicode when the line has no Egyptological letters; '=' (suffix) → '.' either way."""
    t = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", line.strip())
    t = re.sub(r"\{[^}]*\}", "", t).replace("(=", ".(").replace("=", ".")
    if not UNI & set(t):
        t = "".join(MDC.get(c, c) for c in t)
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", t).strip()


def short_sense(senses):
    s = (senses or "").split(";")[0].split(",")[0].strip()
    return s[:40]


class Live:
    def __init__(self):
        self.engine = Engine()
        self.index = load_lexicon()

    def parse(self, text):
        out, prev_date = [], False
        for n, line in enumerate(l for l in text.splitlines() if l.strip()):
            uni = normalize(line)
            pieces = [{"id": i, "line": n, "translit": p, "translit_uni": p, "flags": []}
                      for i, p in enumerate(uni.split(), 1)]
            if not pieces:
                continue
            rows, _ = to_json(words_from(segment(pieces), self.index), self.index)
            res = self.engine.analyze(rows, prev_was_date=prev_date)
            prev_date = all(w["kind"] == "date" for w in rows)
            toks = []
            for w, o in zip(rows, res):
                lemma = self.engine.lex.lemma(o["lemma_id"]) if o["lemma_id"] else None
                toks.append({"t": w["surface"], "upos": o["upos"], "fn": o["fn"], "form": o["form"],
                             "rules": o["rules"], "note": o["note"],
                             "lemma": lemma["lemma"] if lemma else None,
                             "sense": short_sense(lemma["senses"]) if lemma else "",
                             "unsure": o["fn"] == "UNKNOWN" or lemma is None})
            out.append({"text": uni, "tokens": toks})
        return out
